description: Search current job postings by keyword, title, company, place, pay, date and more. No account needed. Call list_fields to find the filter names. Country and employment_type accept comma-separated values or arrays and match any listed value. Pages return up to 50 jobs (limit, default 10), or up to 10 jobs when descriptions is "full"; a larger limit is refused. Pass next_cursor as cursor to see the next page. One search shows up to 250 jobs in total (the last page is shortened to fit), so narrow it with filters to find the right ones; count_jobs tells you how many jobs match without listing them. sort is relevance (best match) or updated (most recently updated). By default each job is a compact summary: rank, job_id, job_ad (the employer-written title, employer and a 200-character snippet of the description), company_id, locations, work_arrangement, pay (min, max, currency, period), posted_at, first_seen_at, posting_url and apply_url. For every field of each job pass view: "full" (descriptions cut to 400 characters, or descriptions: "full" for the whole text), name the top-level properties you need in fields (job_id is always included), or call get_job for one job. You choose how much description each job gets: descriptions: "snippet" (the default) gives a short preview and allows up to 50 jobs per page; descriptions: "full" gives the whole text but allows only 10 jobs per page. To read the full text of just a few jobs, search with snippets, then call get_job on the ones you want. Leave description out of fields to drop it entirely. For job titles, title matches the words as one phrase in that order, so "senior software engineer" misses "Software Engineer, Senior"; title_advanced matches words in any order with AND, OR and NOT, for example senior AND ("software engineer" OR "software developer"), and usually finds more.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous result, to see the next page.

descriptions.description: snippet (default): a short preview of each description, up to 50 jobs per page. full: the whole text, up to 10 jobs per page.

fields.description: Top-level job properties as a comma-separated string or field array; job_id is always included.

country.description: One or more two-letter country codes, comma-separated or as an array (US,CA).

employment_type.description: One or more employment type values, comma-separated or as an array.

first_seen_since.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO time; jobs we first found on or after it. For a daily check for new jobs, pass the time of the last check.

near.description: A US place to search around: a ZIP code (78701), a city with its state (Austin, TX), or latitude,longitude. Use with radius_miles.

pay_min.description: Lowest yearly pay, in pay_currency (default USD). Hourly pay is about yearly / 2,080, so $45 an hour is about 93,600.

posted_since.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO time; jobs posted on or after it.

q.description: Words matched against title and description, ranked by relevance. Every word must match; for a list of skills where any may match, use description_advanced with OR, for example python OR sql OR "data analysis".

remote.description: true is the same as work_arrangement=remote.

state.description: US state, two letters (CA) or full name.

work_arrangement.description: remote, hybrid or in_person; comma-separate several.

limit.description: Jobs per page, 1-50 (1-10 when descriptions is "full"). Default 10.

view.description: compact (default): one short summary per job. full: every field of every job, as the REST API returns it.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
